'''Narenwin Barda''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].

== Appearance ==
She is thin, very short and with a square face. She usually is so quiet that people could forget she was there; she was also mousy around other sisters.

== Strength and abilities ==
Nerenwin is of [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|high average]] strength in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of "{{opsl|24}} or {{opsl|25}}".{{ref|{{twotc}}, Narenwhin Barda}} The lower possible strength matches the stated minimum strength needed to be able to make a [[Traveling|gateway]] of useful size. Barring some below average ability a the Talent, she should be able to Travel.

Being a Yellow sister also usually indicates a skill in [[Healing]].

== History ==
Narenwin is 87 years old; she was born in {{ne|913}} and went to the Tower in {{ne|928}}. After spending twelve years as a [[novice]] and eight as [[Accepted]] she was raised to the [[shawl]] in [[948 NE]]. 

For a time she was the assistant to the head of the Yellow Ajah [[eyes-and-ears]]; during that period she recruited [[Ronde Macura]] as a spy and punished her severely for asking about the [[Black Ajah]].

She later became head of the Ajah eyes-and-ears system, and she has been so for years, rising high in the Yellow hierarchy.

Once a week Narenwin would allow children to bring their pets to her in the Tower, so that she could heal them.

She has no [[Warder]].

== Activities ==
During the Aes Sedai [[Schism]] Narewin stayed in the [[White Tower]] accepting [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]]'s leadership.

[[Ronde Macura]] reported to Narenwin as an eyes-and-ears in [[Mardecin]], [[Amadicia]].{{ref/book|5|10}}

[[Nynaeve]] and [[Elayne]] were sure that Ronde Macura would report them to Narenwin so they changed their plans and adopted disguises. {{ref/book|5|13}}

She was sent by Elaida to [[Dorlan]] to take command of the [[Aes Sedai]] there. She also gave orders to [[Gawyn Trakand]] and the [[Younglings]] from Elaida{{ref/book|10|p}}: they have to take guerilla actions against the rebel army, with the aid of the sisters there.

Some weeks later Narenwin met [[Katerine Alruddin]], who [[Travel]]ed back from the White Tower to Dorlan to inform the sisters in the village that the [[Rebel Aes Sedai|rebels']] [[Amyrlin Seat]], [[Egwene al'Vere]], had been captured.{{ref/book|12|13}} Katerine also taught them the [[weave]]s for Traveling so they could be more effective against the rebels.

But Gawyn also heard from Katerine the news about Egwene and left Dorlan suddenly, leaving Narenwin without the captain of her troops.
